profile.headline: Software Developer at Harris Health System
profile.summary:
“I'm not a great programmer; I'm just a good programmer with great habits.” 
― Kent Beck
This is my favorite quote when it comes to work, life or anything for that matter. I believe nobody is born with a superior set of skills and practice makes perfection. Web and Application developing is my newly found passion. I'd like to think of myself as a life long student. I learn quick and enjoy doing projects for work as well as on the side.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop, Test, Debug Health Information System with Java, SOAP, REST Web servies, GWT/GXT.
- Collaboration Tool: SVN, Crucible, Target Process, Lync ...

positions.title: Automation Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop automation test framework that will automate the smoke/regression test for the VCS21 Communication System. Develop dashboards, metrics to measure the performance of the software and network system in the lab. Automate the requirements verification process.
 
- Technologies used: Selenium, Sikuli, Python, PHP, Code Igniter MVC, HTML5, CSS3, JQuery, Responsive Design, GeoCoding API.

positions.title: Web developer (PHP/MySQL)
positions.description:
- Develop front-end for internal customers. Develop customized spread-sheets used to input, organize data for song collections.
- Technologies used: PHP, MySQL, Postgres, HTML, CSS, Javascript, JQuery, Adobe Photoshop.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Help with back end work for a health care information system.

positions.title: C#
positions.description: Develop Windows and Web Application with .Net 3.5 Framework and C#
